data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'anja' which means 'to support', Anja is a graceful and elegant name. It symbolizes strength and resilience, evoking images of a woman who is unwavering in her faith and steadfast in her commitments. The name anja carries the meaning “Graceful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose anja usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
